link.title: Project
link.description: ZennoPoster Actions for project management: Project in Project (nested projects with parameter/variable passing, execution context, result waiting, and error handling), Input settings (profiles/presets, field types, default values, validation), BotUI Bot Interface (forms, dialog steps, buttons, events, variable binding), Project Encryption (source protection, secrets/keys storage, access rights), Project Notes (logic description, changelog, tags/metadata for search and maintenance).
